content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download AIIMS Bhubaneswar Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Scientist B (Medical) and 1 for Lab. Technician.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Scientist B (Medical): MBBS / BDS / B.V.Sc. & AH recognized by MCI / DCI / VCI respectively. BDS / B. V. Sc degree with one-year experience. Experience: Two years R&D / Teaching experience in relevant subject after obtaining essential qualification. Lab. Technician: B. Sc. / 12th pass in science subject and two years diploma in medical laboratory Technician OR one year DMLT plus one year required experience from any recognized organization in field/laboratory. Experience: Working experience in clinical microbiology laboratory testing.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Scientist B (Medical): Up to 35 years (Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD as per government rules) Lab. Technician: Up to 30 years (Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD as per government rules) Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to be held on 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Scientist-B (Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Scientist-B (Medical) post at AIIMS Bhubaneswar. The recruitment is for a total of two posts, including one Lab. Technician.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Scientist-B (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification for Scientist-B (Medical) is MBBS / BDS / B.V.Sc. & AH recognized by MCI / DCI / VCI respectively, or a BDS / B. V. Sc degree with one year of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Lab. Technician post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Lab. Technician post is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Scientist-B (Medical) position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Scientist-B (Medical) position is 67000 + HRA. For the Lab. Technician, the salary is 28,000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive at AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual posts at AIIMS Bhubaneswar will be based on a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring original documents, self-attested photocopies of certificates, a passport-size photograph, and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhubaneswar, Odisha, 751019. Specific reporting time details are in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is prior online application required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, prior online application is not required. This is a walk-in interview recruitment, and candidates can attend the interview directly with the required documents.
